description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeLeaveModel class within the OrangeHRM human resource management system. It serves as a data model for representing employee leave information in API responses, utilizing traits for serialization and configuring properties and decorators for data normalization. The class encapsulates leave-related attributes such as ID, date, status, leave type, start and end times, duration, and associated requests.
